title: Everything You Need To Know About Eggs - Cage Free, Free Range, Pasture Raised, and More
summary: A grocery walkthrough of egg labels that dismisses cage-free and free-range and recommends certified pasture-raised eggs.

assertions.quote: things like cage free and free-range actually mean nothing
nutritionally speaking it's better than factory farmed eggs

verdicts.note: Pasture access strongly shapes egg fatty-acid composition, but few studies compare eggs and a higher omega-3 content in organic eggs is called plausible but undocumented.

assertions.quote: it's supposed to be safe for us I don't buy that
they're not even inside from early morning to late night they're outside foraging running around eating bugs worms and grass

verdicts.note: There is no USDA definition of pasture-raised; only third-party certifications such as Certified Humane set outdoor space and time rules.
